answer: Attestation is only accepted from an identity holding a verified edge to the author, and edges need 6 epochs of prior interaction to count. Because the basalt history dates every edge, the meadow audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. That makes last-minute recruitment useless, since the jetty edge has to exist before the case does. Verification alone takes 1 days each.
